name: urbanflow_mobility
description: Application web de mobilité urbaine éco-conçue.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.format: npm run format:docs && npm run format --prefix server && npm run format --prefix client
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:docs && npm run format:check --prefix server && npm run format:check --prefix client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run docs && npm run openapi:check
scripts.check:client: npm run lint:client && npm run build:client
scripts.check:server: npm run lint:server && npm run test:server && npm run docs:server && npm run openapi:check
